Mô tả công việc
Tham gia các dự án nghiên cứu và ứng dụng Trí tuệ nhân tạo (AI), đặc biệt là Thị giác máy tính (Computer Vision) vào các bài toán nhận diện và phân loại các loài thực vật.
Tham gia vào quá trình thu thập, tiền xử lý, làm sạch, gán nhãn và chuẩn hóa các bộ dữ liệu hình ảnh thu thập được.
Nghiên cứu, tìm hiểu và áp dụng các
kiến trúc
mạng học sâu (Deep Learning) tiên tiến cho các nhiệm vụ tiền nghiên cứu, huấn luyện và phát triển mô hình phân loại hình ảnh.
Tham gia các nhiệm vụ kiểm thử mô hình, đánh giá và phân tích lỗi dựa trên các chỉ số đánh giá chuẩn để tinh chỉnh và tối ưu hóa độ chính xác.
Viết báo cáo kỹ thuật, tài liệu hóa các quy trình dữ liệu và trình bày kết quả nghiên cứu.
Yêu cầu
Sinh viên năm cuối hoặc đã tốt nghiệp các ngành Công nghệ thông tin, Trí tuệ nhân tạo, Khoa học dữ liệu, Công nghệ Nông nghiệp và các ngành liên quan.
Có kiến thức cơ bản về
lập trình Python
, làm quen với các framework Học sâu như PyTorch, TensorFlow, Keras,... và các thư viện xử lý ảnh (OpenCV, PIL,...).
Có kiến thức nền tảng về Thị giác máy tính (Computer Vision), đặc biệt là các bài toán về phân loại hình ảnh (Image Classification).
Có khả năng đọc hiểu tài liệu nghiên cứu chuyên ngành bằng Tiếng Anh.
Có khả năng làm việc độc lập và làm việc nhóm hiệu quả.
Có tinh thần học hỏi, ham mê nghiên cứu, tính cách cẩn thận, tỉ mỉ và sẵn sàng tham gia các hoạt động thực địa khi cần thiết.
Có khả năng viết báo cáo kỹ thuật và trình bày kết quả nghiên cứu rõ ràng, logic.
Quyền lợi
Được mentor trực tiếp bởi
AI Engineer
, Data Engineer và Technical Lead có kinh nghiệm triển khai dự án thực tế.
Hỗ trợ xác nhận thực tập, đóng dấu báo cáo thực tập và khóa luận tốt nghiệp.
Có cơ hội trở thành Nhân viên chính thức sau giai đoạn thực tập/học việc nếu đạt kết quả tốt.
Có trợ cấp hàng tháng - lộ trình rõ ràng cho TTS.

Mô tả công việc
Bạn sẽ đồng hành cùng team AI của ASOFT trong việc nghiên cứu và triển khai các giải pháp Trí tuệ nhân tạo (AI) ứng dụng vào hệ thống ERP hiện đại:
Tham gia nghiên cứu, phát triển và ứng dụng các mô hình AI/ML/LLM vào sản phẩm và dịch vụ của công ty
Tích hợp các LLM hiện đại như OpenAI, Mistral, Claude, Gemini,... vào hệ thống
Xây dựng mô hình hỗ trợ
lập trình viên
(code assistant, auto-review, v.v.)
Phối hợp xây dựng hệ thống Chatbot AI kết nối với SQL Server, file nội bộ, API hệ thống ERP
Hỗ trợ triển khai AI giúp tự động hóa workflow, phân tích dữ liệu trong hệ thống ERP+
Tối ưu mô hình AI về mặt hiệu suất, độ chính xác và khả năng mở rộng
Phối hợp với đội ngũ Dev triển khai AI vào production thực tế
Yêu cầu
Kỹ năng chuyên ngành:
Là sinh viên năm cuối hoặc vừa tốt nghiệp Đại học chuyên ngành CNTT, Khoa học Máy tính, hoặc tương đương
Có kiến thức nền tảng về AI/ML, LLM, NLP là một lợi thế
Biết làm việc với các ngôn ngữ: Python, C#, JavaScript ([protected info])
Hiểu cơ bản về các framework AI như: TensorFlow, PyTorch, Transformers, LangChain,...
Biết xử lý dữ liệu, hiểu về cấu trúc dữ liệu, thuật toán, có khả năng đọc hiểu tài liệu chuyên ngành bằng
tiếng Anh
Kỹ năng nên có:
Tư duy phân tích, logic tốt, chủ động và trách nhiệm trong công việc
Có khả năng học hỏi nhanh và làm việc nhóm hiệu quả
Tư duy mở, sẵn sàng với các công nghệ mới
Quyền lợi
Thời gian làm việc:
Full time: T2 - T6 (8h - 17h; nghỉ trưa 1 tiếng)
· Tham gia vào các dự án AI thực tế cùng team kỹ thuật nhiều kinh nghiệm
· Cơ hội trở thành nhân viên chính thức sau thực tập nếu thể hiện tốt
· Được training các công nghệ mới (LLM, LangChain, AI ứng dụng vào ERP,...)
· Làm việc tại môi trường công nghệ cao, văn hóa tử tế - đổi mới - hướng tới giá trị bền vững
· Cơ hội phát triển nghề nghiệp rõ ràng, công bằng, theo lộ trình đánh giá minh bạch
Hỗ trợ thủ tục hành chính, hướng dẫn các bạn sinh viên thực hiện báo cáo ngoại khóa, khóa luận,đề án tốt nghiệp

Giới thiệu công ty
Xem trang công ty
ASOFT được khai sinh vào ngày Quốc khánh Mỹ (04 tháng 07) năm 2003, là công ty tư vấn quản lý và cung cấp giải pháp xây dựng hệ thống quản trị doanh nghiệp tự động hàng đầu tại Việt Nam. Với đội ngũ nhân sự giàu kinh nghiệm đã từng tham gia nhiều dự án phần mềm của Nhật Bản, tinh thông kiến thức về quản trị doanh nghiệp và giỏi về công nghệ thông tin (CNTT). Tới tháng 12/2020, ASOFT đã tư vấn và triển khai xây dựng hệ thống cho hơn 3750 doanh nghiệp, trong đó trên 40% là các doanh nghiệp FDI...

(“Công Ty”).
Theo đây, Bạn đồng ý với việc xử lý dữ liệu cá nhân của bạn (bao gồm cả dữ liệu cá nhân cơ bản và dữ liệu cá nhân nhạy cảm), bao gồm nhưng không giới hạn việc thu thập, sử dụng, xóa, lưu trữ, tiết lộ và chuyển giao dữ liệu cá nhân của bạn vì mục đích nêu trên.
Nếu không được Công Ty tuyển dụng, Bạn đồng ý cho Công Ty tiếp tục lưu trữ, sử dụng và chuyền giao dữ liệu cá nhân của bạn trong nội bộ Công Ty hoặc giữa Công Ty và các công ty liên kết của Công Ty nhằm mục đích phục vụ cho nhu cầu tuyển dụng sau này của Công Ty hoặc của các công ty liên kết của Công Ty.

About the Role
We are looking for an experienced
Senior Cloud Engineer
with a strong background in
AWS infrastructure design, deployment, and operations
. The ideal candidate has a solid understanding of AWS core services, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), Kubernetes (EKS), and modern cloud automation practices. You will be responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining scalable, secure, and cost-efficient cloud environments across multiple AWS accounts.
Responsibilities
Design, implement, and manage AWS cloud infrastructure following best practices for scalability, availability, and security.
Operate and maintain AWS environments in
multi-account setups
using AWS Organizations, IAM, and cross-account role management.
Deploy, manage, and optimize
EKS (Elastic Kubernetes Service)
clusters for containerized workloads.
Implement infrastructure provisioning and lifecycle management using
Terraform
,
CloudFormation
, or
AWS CDK
.
Automate configuration management, application deployment, and system updates using
Ansible
or
Chef
.
Monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize performance and cost of AWS services such as
EC2, S3, RDS, and VPC networking
.
Collaborate with developers, DevOps, and security teams to deliver reliable and secure cloud platforms.
Maintain and improve CI/CD pipelines and GitOps workflows for cloud resources and Kubernetes clusters.
Ensure compliance with security and governance standards across all AWS accounts.
Provide technical guidance, documentation, and mentoring to junior engineers when needed.
Yêu cầu công việc
3+ years of hands-on experience
managing AWS cloud environments in production.
Strong understanding of AWS core services:
EC2, VPC, S3, RDS, IAM, EKS
, CloudWatch, and Route53.
Experience operating
EKS clusters
and Kubernetes workloads, including deployment, scaling, and troubleshooting.
Proficiency in at least one
programming or scripting language
(e.g.,
Python, Go, or Bash
).
Experience with
Infrastructure as Code
tools such as
Terraform, CloudFormation, or AWS CDK
.
Familiarity with
configuration management tools
(e.g.,
Ansible, Chef
).
Solid knowledge of
Linux system administration
and shell scripting.
Experience working in
multi-account AWS environments
using AWS Organizations, Control Tower, or custom account management setups.
Good understanding of
cloud networking concepts
, including VPC, subnets, route tables, and security groups.
Strong problem-solving mindset and ability to work independently with high ownership and accountability.
Excellent communication and documentation skills in English.
Nice to Have
AWS certification (e.g.,
AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate/Professional
,
DevOps Engineer
, or
SysOps Administrator
).
Experience with monitoring and observability tools (Prometheus, Grafana, CloudWatch, OpenTelemetry).
Knowledge of CI/CD systems (e.g., GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI).
Exposure to cost optimization, tagging strategies, or FinOps practices.

Tham gia thiết kế, xây dựng và tối ưu cơ sở dữ liệu.

Designer
, Front-end và
Mobile Developer
để triển khai các tính năng theo yêu cầu dự án.
Hỗ trợ kiểm thử, bảo trì và nâng cấp các hệ thống hiện có.
Yêu cầu
Sinh viên năm cuối hoặc mới tốt nghiệp Đại học/Cao đẳng chuyên ngành Công nghệ Thông tin, Khoa học Máy tính, Hệ thống Thông tin hoặc các ngành liên quan.
Có kiến thức cơ bản về lập trình hướng đối tượng (OOP), cấu trúc dữ liệu và giải thuật.
Có kiến thức hoặc đã thực hành với .NET (C#, ASP.NET Core) là một lợi thế.
Có tinh thần trách nhiệm, tư duy logic tốt và khả năng làm việc nhóm.
Chủ động học hỏi, ham tìm hiểu công nghệ mới.
Quyền lợi
Có cơ hội tham gia vào các dự án thực tế của công ty.
Môi trường làm việc chuyên nghiệp, thân thiện, hỗ trợ phát triển kỹ năng chuyên môn.
Được tiếp cận và học hỏi các công nghệ mới trong quá trình làm việc.
Có cơ hội trở thành nhân viên chính thức sau thời gian thực tập.
Hỗ trợ phụ cấp thực tập theo năng lực.

Mô tả công việc
Tham gia phát triển các dự án phần mềm.
Tham gia thực tập Full-time.
Tìm hiểu và phát triển chức năng Web E-Commerce.
Được hướng dẫn về ý thức chất lượng, teamwork.
Một số công việc khác sẽ trao đổi cụ thể trong buổi phỏng vấn.
Yêu cầu
Đã tốt nghiệp Cao đẳng / Đại học hoặc sắp nhận Bằng tốt nghiệp trong vòng 2 tháng (ngành Công nghệ thông tin, Phần mềm).
Có kỹ năng và hiểu biết về: C#, ASP.NET, HTML, CSS, Javascript, VueJS, SQL Server.
Có hiểu biết về E-Commerce là một lợi thế.
Quyền lợi
Được tham gia các hoạt động Team Building như: thể thao, tiệc Công ty.
Môi trường làm việc Nhật Bản thân thiện, năng động, chuyên nghiệp.
Được đánh giá kết quả sau thời gian thực tập để trở thành nhân viên chính thức.
Khi trở thành nhân viên chính thức sẽ được thêm những phúc lợi sau:
Khám sức khỏe định kỳ, du lịch công ty hằng năm.
Tham gia đầy đủ chế độ Bảo hiểm xã hội, Bảo hiểm y tế.
Lương, trợ cấp thỏa thuận theo năng lực làm việc.
Đánh giá Performance 3 tháng 1 lần.
Lương tháng 13.

raw.description_raw:
Gene Solutions is Vietnam's leading biotechnology company, developing AI-powered precision medicine solutions and genomic diagnostics across Asia. Our Oncology team builds intelligent products that support clinicians in delivering faster, more accurate cancer care. We are looking for motivated Product Engineer Interns who want to build impactful healthcare products and grow into future Product Engineers.
About the Role
As a Product Engineer Intern, you will work closely with software engineers, AI scientists, clinicians, and product teams to develop and improve Oncology products used in real clinical workflows. You will receive hands-on, on-the-job coaching through real projects and be mentored by PhD-level scientists and senior AI engineers.
Key Responsibilities
Support the development and maintenance of Oncology products and AI-powered applications.
Collaborate with engineers, clinicians, and product teams to improve product quality and user experience.
Validate AI outputs and clinical knowledge to improve accuracy.
Test new features, investigate issues, and propose product improvements.
Document findings and contribute to product development.
What We're Looking For
Behaviors (Most Important)
Extreme Ownership – Take responsibility and follow through.
Bias Toward Delivery – Focus on delivering value.
Learn Fast, Learn Always – Curious and eager to learn.
Clarity of Intent – Communicate clearly and ask questions.
Act Now, Not Later – Be proactive and execution-oriented.
Qualifications
Final-year undergraduate or graduate student in
Computer Science, AI, Bioinformatics, Data Science, Software Engineering, or related fields.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Technologies you will work with:
Development: Python, REST APIs, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, ClickHouse, Airflow, Minio, Docker, Git, CI/CD.
AI: LLMs, AI Agents, RAG, Prompt Engineering, Model Evaluation.
Available to work on-site at Gene Solutions (Ho Chi Minh city office) for at least 2 full days per week.
Why Join This Internship
Outstanding interns will be considered for a full-time Product Engineer position.
Work directly with PhD-level scientists, senior engineers, and product leaders.
Learn by building real healthcare products.
Take ownership of meaningful projects instead of only supporting routine tasks. Contribute to AI-powered oncology products used in clinical practice across Asia.
Internship lasts 4 months, with performance reviews every 2 months and continuous feedback.
Allowance: 5mil/month
Show more
Show less

Job Details
Job Description:
Data Transformation and Feature Engineering: Clean, join, and transform datasets (structured/unstructured) into highquality features for ML use.
Pipelines and Automation: Develop and maintain ETL/ELT workflows (e.g., Airflow, Spark) for reproducible and dependable data.
Model Prototyping: Explore ML approaches (classification, regression, timeseries, anomaly detection; optional: NLP/LLM) using scikitlearn, PyTorch, or TensorFlow.
Agent AI Development: Assist in designing and implementing AI agents for data processing, decision automation, and conversational interfaces using frameworks like LangChain, CrewAI, or similar.
Evaluation and Iteration: Define metrics, run experiments, compare baselines, and document tradeoffs; track results with MLflow or equivalent.
Data Quality and Governance: Implement validation checks, schema enforcement, and lineage tracking to improve trust in data.
Visualization and Storytelling: Build concise dashboards/notebooks (Power BI, Plotly, matplotlib) and present findings to stakeholders.
Qualifications
Currently pursuing a Bachelor's in Computer Science, Data Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field. Graduating Soon: You'll be finishing your degree in 2027.
Be able to work onsite for 4 days per week.
Be able to commit to at least a 6-month internship program.
English Skills: Ability to explain technical ideas clearly in English.
Coursework or experience in statistics, machine learning, data structures/ algorithms, and database fundamentals.
Proficiency in Python (pandas, NumPy, scikitlearn) and SQL.
Familiarity with one deeplearning framework (PyTorch or TensorFlow).
Basic understanding of ETL/ELT concepts and data modeling (star/snowflake).
Clear communication; ability to document work and present technical findings.
Job Type
Student / Intern
Shift
Shift 1 (Vietnam)
Primary Location:
Vietnam, Ho_Chi_Minh_City

Ho Chi Minh City (on-site, with flexibility)
Type:
Internship, 3 months · Full-time (Mon–Fri)
Team:
Technology
Allowance:
5,000,000 VND gross/month
After the internship:
Opportunity to convert to a full-time role
Why this role exists
Most internships give you a sandbox project that gets deleted when you leave. This one doesn't.
MyStorage runs a real business — self-storage, valet storage, hyperlocal lockers, and wine storage — serving thousands of customers across Vietnam, Korea, and Japan. Our tech team is small and the backlog is not. Our AI Sales Agent, which handles customer conversations and helps drive our sales pipeline, has won regional awards for technology and innovation.
We're looking for one intern who can take a problem, build the thing, and ship it to production — with
Claude Code
as their primary engineering tool. Your work will be used by real customers and real colleagues within weeks of joining.
Three months full-time is enough to do this properly: a couple of weeks to get your bearings and ship your first small things, then the rest of the time owning real work end to end. Do it well and there's a full-time role waiting.
What you'll actually do
Ship features to production.
Customer-facing pages on our website (modern web stack), internal dashboards, and booking flows. Real PRs, real code review, real deploys.
Build internal tools that remove manual work.
Our Sales, Marketing, and Operations teams still do things by hand that shouldn't be done by hand. You'll find those tasks and automate them — workflow automation, CRM integrations, internal bots and dashboards.
Work on our AI Sales Agent.
Prompt design, evaluation, tool integrations, and the plumbing that connects an AI agent to a live sales pipeline.
Wire up data.
Analytics tracking, data pipelines, and turning messy operational data into something a human can make a decision from.
Prototype fast.
When someone on the team says "I wish we had X," you should be able to have a working version in front of them the same week.
How we work (and what "AI-native" means here)
Claude Code is our default way of building. That does
not
mean prompting until something compiles. It means:
You write a clear spec before you write code — because a vague spec produces vague software, whether a human or a model writes it.
You read every line the model produces and you can defend it in review. If you can't explain it, it doesn't ship.
You know when to reach for AI and when to just write the code yourself. Both are correct answers in different situations.
You test. Generated code that looks right and is wrong is worse than no code at all.
We care far more about how much real product you can ship than about how many years of experience you have.
What we're looking for
Required
Available full-time for 3 consecutive months.
This role suits final-year students and recent graduates best — but if you're an earlier-year student who can genuinely commit five days a week for three months, we want to hear from you too
Final-year student, recent graduate, or self-taught builder — degree not required
Comfortable with JavaScript/TypeScript
or
Python, and Git
You've built and shipped something outside of coursework. A side project, a bot, an automation, a tool for a friend's business — anything with real users, even five of them
Genuine hands-on experience with AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot) and honest opinions about where they help and where they don't
Working English (our docs and codebase are in English; the team speaks Vietnamese day-to-day)

SQL, BigQuery, or any data warehouse
Experience with LLM APIs, RAG, agents, or MCP
Automation platforms (n8n, Zapier, Make, or similar)
An eye for design — you notice when something looks wrong

, with your name on them, that you can point to in every future interview
Direct mentorship
from our engineering team, plus exposure to how Commercial, Marketing, and Operations actually make decisions
A full Claude Code license
and the tooling budget to work properly
A serious conversion path.
We hire from this internship. Ship well over three months and we'll make you a full-time offer
Small-company leverage.

About the Role: Product Intern / Fresher
Join a YC-backed AI hiring startup and help shape the future of AI collaboration. As a Product Intern/Fresher, your primary focus will be on understanding and optimizing the "User Journey." Our platform serves thousands of candidates daily, and your mission will be to delve into their motivations and behaviors: Why do they sign up? Where do they encounter friction? How can we enhance the product's value to transform users into advocates?
Key Responsibilities
Product Ideation & Strategy: Contribute to brainstorming and strategic discussions, identifying user pain points and proposing new features that drive growth and engagement.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work with Engineering on feasibility, Marketing on launch messaging, and Operations to understand real-time user feedback.
Funnel Optimization: Analyze data to identify areas for improvement in the user journey. For example, investigate why only 40% of users complete their profile and propose strategies to increase this to 60%.
Feature Specifications & Documentation: Write clear, concise requirements for new features and assist in maintaining the product roadmap.
Product Testing (QA): Test new features before launch to ensure a polished user experience and identify any bugs.
Launch Management: Help coordinate feature releases, ensuring alignment across Marketing, Operations, and Technology teams for successful rollouts.
What We're Looking For
Data-Driven Intuition: You can use data to inform decisions while maintaining empathy for user psychology.
Clear Communicator: You can explain complex ideas simply and write concise requirements.
Entrepreneurial Spirit: You are interested in how products grow from inception to scale. You are eager to learn about Product-Led Growth (PLG) and viral loops.
Design Sensibility: While not a designer, you have a good sense of what constitutes a "clean" and "trustworthy" user interface.
Bonus: A strong interest in tech products, data analytics, or coding. Curiosity about how software is built is a significant plus.
What We Offer
Competitive Remuneration: Monthly compensation will be provided, tailored to your experience level.
Startup Scaling Insights: Gain direct insights into how YC-backed Silicon Valley startups build and scale products.
Real Impact: See your ideas implemented and directly influence the user experience for thousands.
Mentorship: Work closely with the Founder and the Product team.
How to Apply
Ready to make an impact? Apply now!
We review applications on a rolling basis. In your application, demonstrate your understanding of user behavior and motivation.
Show more
Show less

Hrs As a Company
HRS, a pioneer in business travel, aims to elevate every stay through innovative technology. With over 50 years of experience, their digital platform, driven by ProcureTech, TravelTech, and FinTech, transforms how companies and travelers Stay, Work, and Pay.
ProcureTech digitally revolutionizes lodging procurement, connecting corporations and suppliers in a cutting-edge ecosystem. This enables seamless efficiency and automation, surpassing travelers' expectations.
TravelTech redefines the online lodging experience, offering personalized content from selection to check-in, ensuring an unparalleled journey for corporate travelers.
In FinTech, HRS introduces advancements like mobile banking and digital payments, turning corporate back offices into touchless lodging enablers, eliminating legacy cost barriers. The innovative 2-click book-to-pay feature streamlines interactions for travelers and hoteliers.
Combining these technology propositions, HRS unlocks exponential catalyst effects. Their data-driven focus delivers value-added services and high-return network effects, creating substantial customer value.
HRS's exponential growth since 1972 serves over 35% of the global Fortune 500 and leading hotel chains.
Join HRS to shape the future of business travel, empowered by a culture of growth and setting new industry standards worldwide.
BUSINESS UNIT
The
Search & Book unit
at HRS plays a pivotal role in delivering innovative solutions through HRS Connect, the company's flagship product within the expansive global corporate travel management market. HRS Connect specifically targets the rapidly growing and significantly underserved segments of corporate lodging, meetings, groups, and long stays.
The unit develops, enhances, and maintains complex technology solutions that seamlessly integrate hotel distribution systems, Property Management Systems (PMS), Online Travel Agencies (OTA), and Hotel Chain systems into the HRS Connect platform.
POSITION
A Middle - Senior Fullstack Engineer (AI-Native) builds production-grade applications and intelligent workflows with an AI-first mindset across the full software development lifecycle. This role is for an engineer who does not treat AI as an add-on, but as a core way of working across design, implementation, testing, documentation, debugging, and delivery.
The ideal candidate consistently approaches work by asking whether a task can be completed entirely with AI or materially improved through AI-assisted execution, while still applying strong engineering judgment and quality controls.
CHALLENGE
Full-Stack Engineering: Design, build, and maintain scalable applications using Next.js/TypeScript (frontend) and Java/Python (backend).
AI-Native Product Development: Integrate GenAI APIs and LLM-powered capabilities into core product workflows. Build agentic flows, tool-using systems, and AI workflow automations with clear guardrails and observability.
AI-Native Engineering Practice: Apply AI-assisted workflows across the full SDLC - from design and implementation to testing, debugging, and documentation. Review and validate AI-generated outputs for correctness, security, and production readiness.
Technical Leadership: Drive architectural decisions, mentor engineers, and champion AI-native engineering practices across the team.
FOR THIS EXCITING MISSION YOU ARE EQUIPPED WITH...
5+ years of professional full-stack engineering experience across frontend, backend, APIs, databases, and production systems, with strong end-to-end ownership of product delivery.
Hands-on expertise with Next.js, React, and TypeScript, including server-side rendering, component-based architecture, and state management.
Strong backend development skills in Java and/or Python, with solid understanding of system architecture, scalability, and production reliability.
Experience integrating GenAI APIs, LLM features, assistants, or AI-powered product capabilities into production systems.
Immersive adoption of AI across the SDLC. Demonstrated experience using AI-assisted development workflows for scaffolding, refactoring, testing, debugging, documentation, and delivery while critically reviewing outputs and maintaining engineering standards.
AI-first mindset. Approaches every task by asking whether it can be completed entirely with AI or improved significantly through AI, then applies the right level of human review, validation, and control.
Excellent communication skills and fluency in English to collaborate effectively in an international environment.
LOCATION, MOBILITY, INCENTIVE
Competitive Pay: Attractive salary package with a 13th-month bonus and Reward bonus
Hybrid Working Model: Embrace flexibility of working from both home and office that supports better work-life balance and boosts productivity
Recognition That Matters: We celebrate your milestones with meaningful rewards and long-term commitment opportunities (after 2 years, 5 years, 10 years, etc. of service)
Comprehensive Benefits: Private health insurance for you and family member, plus full statutory coverage (social, health, unemployment)
Time to Recharge: 18 days of paid leave per year, including sick days
Continuous Growth: Dedicated learning budget, access to Udemy, English classes, mentoring, and global workshop/business forum opportunities
Support for Your Day-to-Day: Meal and parking allowances to keep life simple
Culture That Empowers: Company trips, year-end celebrations, structured quarterly team bonding, culture activities for x-team collaboration — because strong teams drive meaningful outcomes
Refer and Earn: Generous referral bonus for every successful hire you bring in
Location: Anna Building (District 12), HCMC/Lim Tower 3, Nguyen Dinh Chieu Street (District 1), HCMC

Job Description
Job Purpose & Dimensions:
We are looking for an engineer to maintain and enhance a design data management platform that supports product development, documentation, and engineering collaboration.
This role covers application development, platform operations, release support, user enablement, and integration with related engineering systems.
Principal Accountabilities:
Develop and maintain application features based on engineering and business requirements.
Support software releases, testing, deployment, and user communication.
Administer platform infrastructure, environments, and system performance.
Plan and execute system upgrades, migrations, and service improvements.
Implement monitoring, troubleshooting, and reliability practices.
Provide user support, training, and clear technical documentation.
Integrate the platform with other tools and services in the engineering environment.
Collaborate with stakeholders to prioritize improvements and support adoption.
Key Performance Measures:
Platform reliability, performance, and service availability.
Timely delivery of planned releases and improvements.
Successful execution of upgrades and migration activities.
Effective monitoring, issue resolution, and continuous improvement.
Positive user feedback and strong adoption of the platform.
Ability to learn new technologies and adapt to evolving needs.
Strong collaboration and contribution to team goals.
Knowledge, Skills and Experience:
Experience in full-stack application development on ASP.NET + IIS, C# & C++ programming languages and database-backed systems.
Strong database knowledge, including query development and performance tuning.
Experience with server administration and application hosting environments.
Familiarity with cloud infrastructure and deployment concepts.
Experience with monitoring, diagnostics, and incident response practices.
Proficiency in scripting and automation for operational tasks.
Understanding of release management, testing, and deployment workflows.
Knowledge of infrastructure, networking, and migration planning.
Familiarity with project tracking and Agile ways of working.
Comfortable working in cross-functional teams and iterative delivery models.
Interest in modern development tools and continuous improvement.
Knowledge of APIs and system integration patterns is a plus.
Experience in engineering, technical documentation, or data management domains is beneficial.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
Qualifications
Solid understanding of modern software development practices and C#, C++ VB.NET or similar programming languages.
Bachelor or Master degree with relevant background (Computer Science, IT, Engineering, or related).
Minimum 3–5 years of professional experience in application development and/or infrastructure engineering.
Business fluent in English.
Key Relationships:
Partner with engineering users and stakeholders to gather needs and feedback.
Collaborate with product, infrastructure, and operations teams.
Work with technical specialists to support hosting and service reliability.
Engage with users to support adoption, training, and continuous improvement.
Coordinate across teams to balance service quality, priorities, and delivery.
Contribute to a collaborative and knowledge-sharing team culture.

.’ As the industry’s leading expert in embedded processing with unmatched quality and system-level know-how, we have evolved to provide scalable and comprehensive semiconductor solutions for automotive, industrial, infrastructure, and IoT industries based on the broadest product portfolio, including High Performance Computing, Embedded Processing, Analog & Connectivity, and Power.

.’

Maximize your performance and wellbeing
in our flexible and inclusive work environment. Our people-first culture and global support system, including the remote work option and Employee Resource Groups, will help you excel from the first day.

Join Renesas. Let’s
Shape the Future
together.

Junior Fullstack Developer (ReactJS + NodeJS)
About VeXeRe – Revolutionizing The Way Vietnam Travels
VeXeRe is Vietnam’s No.1 online bus ticketing platform, connecting over 2,000 transport operators and serving millions of passengers every month. We pioneer technology to modernize the transportation industry, bringing users a fast, seamless, and optimized booking experience.
Beyond buses, VeXeRe is expanding into flights, trains, and car rentals — giving travelers complete freedom of choice for every journey.
Our Culture
At VeXeRe, we believe our mission is to solve real-world social problems through technology. Our culture is built on openness, collaboration, and community spirit. Every member is encouraged to think freely, share ideas, and take ownership — with the opportunity to grow into future leaders.
Our Vision
We aim to become a continuously innovating tech company that revolutionizes transportation and travel across Southeast Asia through AI-native solutions. Every experience — from customer journeys to internal systems — is being reimagined to be smarter, faster, and more human.
Why Join Us
Joining VeXeRe means being part of a young, energetic, and ambitious tech team where you’ll have the freedom to experiment, learn from top engineers, and grow rapidly as we scale.
About The Role
Are you ready to grow from a developer into a system builder?
At VeXeRe, you’ll learn how to design, build, and scale applications that serve millions of users nationwide — all while working with experienced mentors who’ll guide you every step of the way.
We’re building a modern microservices-based ecosystem with
CI/CD, containerization, and cloud infrastructure
, where you’ll get real hands-on experience with production-level systems.
Our Tech Stack
Backend: Node.js, Express.js, RabbitMQ / Kafka, PostgreSQL / Redis / Elasticsearch, Docker / Kubernetes / Jenkins
Frontend: React.js, ES6 / TypeScript, Redux / Redux-Saga / Hooks
Responsibilities
Develop high-quality solutions to meet business requirements by designing, coding, and shipping well-structured, maintainable software.
Identify and address technical debt & challenges: Proactively analyze areas for improvement and implement changes to enhance system performance and scalability.
Collaborate and share knowledge within the Frontend Squad to maximize team expertise and personal growth.
Take ownership: Lead a team or a product if capable, contributing to technical direction and best practices.
Requirements
Must-Have:
Proactive mindset, curiosity, and a drive to learn.
Fast learner, able to adapt quickly to new technologies.
2 – 3 years of hands-on experience in software development (frontend ).
Familiarity with macOS or Linux for development and deployment tasks.
Understanding of our technology stack (no need to master everything, but familiarity is required):
Backend: Node.js, PostgreSQL, Redis, Elasticsearch.
Frontend: React.js, Redux, Redux-Saga, Reselect, React Hooks.
Commitment to code quality:
Strong experience in code reviews.
Familiarity with unit testing best practices.
Growth mindset: Ready to grow rapidly as the company scales several times a year.
Nice-to-Have (Plus)
Solid foundation in computer science (data structures, algorithms).
Experience with Docker, CI/CD pipelines, or microservices architecture.
Previous experience building and shipping real-world applications.
Benefits
Competitive Compensation & Bonuses
Attractive salary package with performance-based monthly bonuses (up to 2 months’ salary per year).
100% salary during the probation period.
Performance reviews twice a year with opportunities for salary adjustments.
Flexible Work & Growth Opportunities
Hybrid working model (work from home or at the office).
Learn directly from our CTO, Tech Leads, and Senior Engineers.
Build your public tech profile by:
Writing on Medium & VeXeRe Tech Blog under your own name.
Contributing to VeXeRe’s open-source projects.
Speaking at internal or public tech talks.
Attractive stock options for long-term contributors.
Exclusive Employee Perks
Up to 30% discount on bus tickets for Vexere employees and their families.
12 annual leave days + 1 additional day every 3 years (convertible to salary).
Vibrant and friendly working environment.
Training sessions on soft skills, communication, and modern technologies.
Exciting company activities: team building trips, year-end parties, and more.
What factors can help you trust Vexere?
VeXeRe is the largest intercity bus booking platform in Vietnam, partnering with over 1,000 bus operators across 3,000 domestic and cross-border routes.
Our Bus Management System (BMS) is trusted by 700+ transport companies nationwide, helping them modernize operations and boost efficiency.
We’re backed by prestigious investors including
Woowa Brothers (Baemin), CyberAgent Ventures (Japan), BonAngels (Korea), Pix Vine Capital (Singapore), Spiral Ventures (Japan), Access Ventures (Korea), and NCore Ventures (Korea)
— two of which are
Decacorns
valued over USD 10 billion.
Review about Vexere
For More Information, Please Contact Us Via
Send your resume to careers@vexere.com

Trusting Social is an AI Fintech pioneer that's revolutionizing credit access in emerging markets. Our mission is "Advancing AI to Meet the Financial Needs of Everyday Consumers with Empathy." We've assessed over 1 billion consumers across four countries, and we're on a mission to provide 100 million credit lines using the power of AI and Big Data.
How You'll Make an Impact
Join Trusting Social as a Full-Stack AI Engineer II and help build products that are transforming financial services in Vietnam and beyond. You will contribute to our Co-Lending partnership initiatives, building systems across the full stack (backend, web and mobile) that enable fast, scalable credit evaluation and secure integration with banks, partners, and third-party platforms.
Your work will help power instant registration, real-time credit approval, and automated decisioning at scale. As an Engineer II, you deliver features end-to-end within a defined scope with increasing autonomy, working AI-native and broadening your skills across the full stack as you grow
What You'll Do
Deliver high-quality features end-to-end across the full stack (backend, web, mobile), working with cross-functional teams and ensuring systems are reliable, highly scalable, and fault-tolerant.
Work AI-native, orchestrating agents: frame the problem for the agent, delegate the implementation, run multiple agent sessions per day, and spend your own time on direction, quality review, and the hard edge cases.
Build and maintain the tests, evals, and harnesses that agents depend on, so the system stays legible and reliable.
Follow Agile/DevOps and CI/CD to deliver quality code at speed.
Identify and resolve technical challenges within your scope with increasing autonomy.
Support and mentor new joiners, and share knowledge that raises team productivity.
Continuously learn and stay current with advances in software engineering and AI technologies.
Perform other work duties as assigned by the line manager.
Beyond the core
These Are The Dimensions We Grow Our Engineers Into — And It's a Plus If You Already Operate In One Or More Of Them
Domain expert & architect: learn a relevant partner/product area and encode its rules into reusable skills and docs that others and AI agents can reuse; contribute product and design judgment, not just implementation.
Platform & operations owner: operate and monitor agent-assisted systems in production, holding the bar on reliability, security, and quality at the integration boundary.
Partner-facing engineer: manage trust at the partner/client boundary within your scope, and communicate clearly across functions.
What We're Looking For
AI-native delivery: a track record of (or clear eagerness for) shipping production work by orchestrating AI coding agents — running multiple agent sessions, directing and reviewing their output, and building the tests and harnesses that keep it reliable.
Full-stack engineering: solid technical foundation with 4+ years of software engineering across backend and frontend (web or mobile); experience building distributed systems, banking, or fintech is a plus.
Security-aware by default: you keep data protection, access control, and auditability in mind, and are comfortable working within banking/partner compliance constraints.
Strong sense of ownership and accountability for product quality and delivery timelines.
A collaborative team player who contributes positively to the team environment.
Proactive, open-minded, and quick to learn.
Motivated to raise the bar and continuously improve products and engineering practices.
Good communication skills with working proficiency in English.

Be part of a winning team with exponential growth regionally, experience recruiting world-class talents

raw.description_raw:
Rockstars wanted. Apply here!!
Do you ever see a new technology and immediately think: “How can I build with this?” A new AI tool? A new framework? A new programming language? You want to try everything. You have more ideas than time, more things you want to learn than hours in the day.
You’re the person who gets excited about what technology can do and can’t wait to turn ideas into something real. You don’t want to spend your internship just watching tutorials or fixing small pieces of someone else’s work. You want to understand how things are built, solve real problems, and learn from engineers who can show you how it’s done.
At Gradion, you’ll work with experienced engineers, explore modern technologies, and build things that turn your curiosity into real skills.
If you’re always asking “what’s next?” and can’t wait to start building, this internship opportunity is yours.
About Us:
Gradion is the strategic partner ambitious businesses turn to for breakthrough growth, powered by Digital Innovation and Deep Tech.
We're global, AI-first, and a little obsessed with helping clients reshape strategies, optimize systems, and build the kind of tech that shapes what comes next.
From AI and data to cybersecurity, robotics, and enterprise platforms, we build the practical stuff behind tomorrow's billion-dollar companies. But great technology doesn’t happen by simply writing code. It happens because engineers keep learning, challenge assumptions, and turn ideas into solutions.
And that's where you come in.
This is not a typical internship where you only fix small bugs, complete assigned tasks, or watch experienced engineers from the sidelines. You will have the opportunity to:
Build features and improvements for real software projects.
Learn how professional engineers approach problems, design solutions, write code, test, and deliver products.
Work with experienced engineers who can guide you through the journey and help you grow faster.
Explore different technologies and discover where you want to develop deeper expertise.
Use AI tools like ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, and Gemini to research, prototype, debug, and improve how you work.
Join technical discussions, receive feedback, and continuously improve your engineering skills.
Collaborate with engineers and other Academy Fellows to solve meaningful challenges.
You won’t just learn how software is built. You’ll start building it yourself.
What You’ll Unlock 🚀
This is more than an internship. If you’re a rockstar, you’ll get a full-time offer and the opportunity to start your career at Gradion.
You’ll also get:
🚀
You'll build things that actually matter:
Work on real projects and create software you can be proud to talk about.
🌱
You'll grow faster with the right people around you:
Learn from experienced engineers who can help you avoid the wrong turns and focus on what really matters.
🤖
You'll work AI-first from day one:
Use modern AI tools to learn faster, experiment more, and become a more effective engineer.
🎯
You'll discover your engineering path:
Explore different technologies and understand where your strengths and interests fit best.
💼 Monthly internship allowance and company laptop provided.
🎉 Team activities, workshops, Demo Days, and company events.
Before You Apply…
No perfect resume needed. If you’re curious about technology, love solving problems, and can’t wait to start building, that’s enough to apply.
You don’t need to know every programming language or master every framework. You need curiosity, the willingness to learn, and the drive to turn ideas into something real.
One more thing worth knowing before you hit apply: you'd be joining Vietnam's Best IT Company, recognized by ITViec for 8 consecutive years, including 2 years ranked #1. That reputation didn't happen overnight. It's built on 23+ years of building real digital platforms and deep-tech solutions for ambitious businesses around the world.
So while you're learning how great engineers build, you're doing it inside a company that already knows how to build things that matter.
Start building what comes next.
Working time:
Monday - Friday (9 AM - 6 PM)
Location:
Unit No.PF-08 on Podium Floor, Sapphire 2 tower, 92 Nguyen Huu Canh Street, Thanh My Tay Ward, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam.

Our Journey
The ShopBack Group is Asia-Pacific’s leading shopping, rewards, and payments platform, serving over 20 million active members across 13 markets. In 2025, the Group continued its global growth with its expansion into North America. Driven by the vision to make every day more rewarding, ShopBack is dedicated to saving members money and time, and delivering delight every day. The platform also enables merchants and brands to engage with their members in a cost-effective manner. Founded in 2014, ShopBack now powers over US$5.5 billion in annual sales for over 20,000 online and in-store partners, and has rewarded shoppers with more than US$900 million (over S$1 billion) in Cashback to date. Through its innovative offerings, ShopBack continues to create value for both members and merchants. Notably, its payment solution, ShopBack Pay, offers members a convenient and rewarding payment option at checkout.
Your Adventure Ahead
Improve coverage of new and existing platforms, inclusive of native mobile and responsive web apps
Improve and maintain test automation across our entire tech stack
Write, maintain, and run tests
Identify bugs in new and existing code, determine root causes, and suggest possible bug fixes
Collaborate with QA engineers across our 4 technology hubs to improve service quality and delivery velocity

Computer Science or related major

Agency - We take ownership and act, rather than waiting for permission. When something's blocking progress, we find a way through it and follow through until it's done.

Learning Velocity - We pick up new skills fast and let go of old habits just as quickly when something better comes along. We benchmark ourselves against the best and keep raising our own bar.
Tenacity - We stay in it when things get hard, keeping a level head under pressure. We debate openly before deciding, then commit fully — and support each other along the way.

Career growth opportunities to take on greater challenges that help you realise your ambitions.

Candid, open, and collaborative culture where feedback is valued.

raw.description_raw:
About GeoComply
We’re GeoComply! We are at the forefront of geolocation, cybersecurity, and anti-fraud innovation, developing and delivering cutting-edge technologies to help ensure regulatory compliance, combat bad online actors, alleviate user friction, and protect businesses from fraud.
Achieving significant business and revenue growth over the past three years and dubbed a tech “Unicorn,” GeoComply has been trusted by leading global brands and regulators for over ten years. Our compliance-grade geolocation technology solutions are installed on over 400 million devices and analyze over 12 billion transactions a year.
At the heart of it all is the people, united by a deep commitment to problem-solving and revolutionizing how people and businesses use the internet to instill confidence in every online interaction. With teams across five countries, three continents, and a global customer base, we have no plans to slow down.
The Role
The Security Software Engineer Intern contributes to GeoComply’s success by helping strengthen GeoGuard’s VPN and anonymizer detection. Our data collection systems (proxy, residential-proxy, browser-extension, and smart-DNS based collectors) continuously gather the VPN/proxy IP data that powers our detection database, so their performance and the quality of our detection logic directly drive our coverage and accuracy. This position reports to the Technical Product Manager, with day-to-day support from a Software Engineer (SWE).
You are able to, and enjoy, working with multiple teams across locations, and have good communication and interpersonal skills. You are curious about how systems fail, comfortable investigating problems in code and data, and enjoy working in short, agile, iterative development cycles. You actively apply AI tools in your day-to-day research and development work.
Key Responsibilities
Investigate performance issues in our VPN/proxy data collection systems — low IP collection rates, coverage gaps, and recurring failures across proxy, residential-proxy, browser-extension, and smart-DNS based collectors (PHP-based).
Diagnose root causes of degradation and identify what else we can do to improve collection rate, freshness, and coverage.
Fix common failures following established procedures, and propose enhancements to avoid repeat failures.
Build new collectors for VPN/proxy providers following existing templates, and enable auto-updater tooling for new providers.
Support the config auto-updater (JS-based): fix recurring updater failures, handle CAPTCHA-related issues (Cloudflare, reCAPTCHA v3), and manually update configs when auto-updaters fail.
Run VPN testing across a set of VPN applications and research current VPN technology to understand how it behaves and evolves.
Apply AI tools to research VPN providers — identify their spoofing techniques and the corresponding detection and protection methods GeoGuard can use against them.
Explore and propose what else we can do to detect VPN users — new signals, heuristics, or techniques that improve detection coverage.
Query performance and detection data to identify anomalies and establish healthy baselines and alert thresholds.
Build automated, data-driven monitoring — from raw data, to anomaly/alert-detection logic, to a visual dashboard the team can use on an ongoing basis — so degradation is caught proactively rather than after the fact.
Document testing results, recurring failure patterns, and research findings to drive process improvement.
Who You Are
Recently graduated or in pursuit of a degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
Basic backend development knowledge (PHP and/or Golang preferred).
Comfortable querying and working with data to spot patterns and anomalies.
